author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before drew the spool as a D-shaped box and the ball with an S curve and a V on top (read as 'DØ'); redrawn after the reference: a spool with overhanging flanges and a thread wrap, a round yarn ball with a diagonal wrapped strand, a round-headed pin and a knitting needle stuck in its top.
omissions: Reference's three ball stripes reduced to one (an r10 ball has no second chord 8 units away without slivers); spool shortened to 22 so the pin head clears it; second needle has no head (no room at 8 spacing).
